data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'aspasios', meaning 'hope' or 'breath of God'. In Greek mythology, Aspasia was a wise woman who advised Pericles, a famous Athenian statesman. In Christianity, the name Aspasia symbolizes the hope that God breathes into us. The name Aspasia carries the meaning “Hope, God-breathed” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aspasia usually hope their child will grow to embody hope, god-breathed and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aspasia total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
